strongest_bounded_proposition: Later/contact Amazonian scholarship documents captive incorporation and slavery-like relations in some contexts, but not this broad region at c.1300.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not back-project post-contact/ethnographic relations or treat Amazonia as one society.
territorial_practice_summary: Target-specific anchor-period slavery practice not established.
terminology_category_qualification: Captivity, dependency and slavery are not equated automatically.
temporal_scope_precision: Broad challenge context; later ethnographic/contact evidence is not silently back-projected.
inference_extent: Broad research context only; not one polity or society.
language_access_limitations: Retrospective ethnography/post-contact sources dominate; archaeological/Indigenous-language evidence underrepresented.
